metadata.title: Datastore Checks (technology-agnostic) - SC-28 / SC-28(1)
metadata.remarks: Technology-agnostic contract for the OPA/Rego checks in policies/datastores. It names each check (Check_Id), the rule it verifies (Rule_Id), the input it reads (the datastore inventory schema) and the controls/objectives it provides evidence for. It contains nothing platform-specific: a platform-specific component definition reuses these Rule_Ids on its own service component, and a platform adapter produces the inventory. Rules and checks use trestle/C2P-style props; the 'remarks' value (rule_set_00, rule_set_01) groups props that belong to the same rule.

components.title: OPA datastore checks
components.description: Open Policy Agent policies in policies/datastores. Each policy evaluates a datastore inventory (see the schema resource) and returns one deny result per non-compliant datastore, as {id, msg}. A missing or non-boolean value is non-compliant: adapters must state platform defaults explicitly.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Every datastore encrypts its stored data, logs and backups with a cryptographic mechanism.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: Rego data.datastores.encryption_at_rest.deny (policies/datastores/encryption_at_rest.rego): every datastore in the inventory reports encryption_at_rest.enabled = true.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Every datastore cryptographically records changes to its stored data so that unauthorized modification is detectable.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: Rego data.datastores.tamper_evidence.deny (policies/datastores/tamper_evidence.rego): every datastore in the inventory reports tamper_evidence.enabled = true.

control-implementations.description: Which checks provide evidence for SC-28 and SC-28(1). Applies to any datastore technology for which an adapter produces the inventory.

implemented-requirements.description: Evidence for sc-28_obj: datastore_encrypted_at_rest (check encryption_at_rest) for confidentiality; datastore_tamper_evident (check tamper_evidence) for integrity. Which of the two apply depends on the values selected for sc-28_odp.01 in the platform component definition or SSP.

Evidence for sc-28.1_obj-1 (prevent unauthorized disclosure): datastore_encrypted_at_rest (check encryption_at_rest). Evidence for sc-28.1_obj-2 (prevent unauthorized modification): datastore_tamper_evident (check tamper_evidence); note that tamper evidence detects rather than prevents modification.
